name: Filmmaker
description: Plans, directs, and oversees the production of films — coordinating crew, managing shoots, and making creative and logistical decisions throughout production.

name: Data Engineer
description: Builds and maintains the systems that collect, store, and process data — pipelines, databases, and infrastructure that other teams depend on for analytics and decision-making.

name: Structural Engineer
description: Analyzes and designs structures to ensure they can safely support the loads they will carry — calculating forces, sizing structural members, and producing engineering drawings.

name: Data Scientist
description: Investigates data to find patterns, build models, and answer questions — writing code, running experiments, and communicating findings to inform decisions.

name: Software Engineer
description: Designs, writes, tests, and maintains software — solving technical problems, debugging issues, and building systems that users and other engineers depend on.
